mapper.insert: insert into `training_task` (training_plan_id, staff_user_id,staff_user_met_id, start_time, end_time, status) values (#{trainingPlanId}, #{staffUserId}, #{staffUserMetId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT tt.*, tp.title AS trainingPlanTitle, su.name AS mentorName FROM `training_task` tt JOIN `training_plan` tp ON tt.training_plan_id = tp.id JOIN `staff_user` su ON tt.staff_user_met_id = su.id WHERE tt.staff_user_id = #{staffUserId}

SELECT tt.*, tp.title AS trainingPlanTitle, su.name AS staffUserName, mentor.name AS mentorName FROM `training_task` tt JOIN `training_plan` tp ON tt.training_plan_id = tp.id JOIN `staff_user` su ON tt.staff_user_id = su.id JOIN `staff_user` mentor ON tt.staff_user_met_id = mentor.id
AND tp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{trainingPlanTitle}, '%')
AND su.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{staffUserName}, '%')
ORDER BY tt.id DESC
